title: Wisdom & Discernment
intro: A toddler's wisdom is mostly about listening, stopping, and telling the truth about the broken cup. These are not small things — they are the whole foundation. This month uses the plainest words for them and tries not to make being good sound like being quiet.

keyScriptures.text: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
Listen, my son, to your father's instruction.

weeks.title: Stop and Listen
weeks.declaration: Stopping when someone calls you is one of the wisest things you can learn. It keeps you safe.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, help our child learn to stop and listen. Make our voice one they want to obey. Amen.

weeks.title: Telling the Truth
weeks.declaration: When something goes wrong, you can tell us. We would always rather know.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make this house safe for the truth. Let our child never be afraid to tell us. Amen.

weeks.title: Asking Is Good
weeks.declaration: If you do not know, you can ask. Asking is what clever people do.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, keep our child curious. Give us patience for the hundredth question. Amen.

weeks.title: Choosing Well
weeks.declaration: You are learning to choose. Some choices are good and some are not, and you are getting better at telling.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, guide the small choices our child is learning to make. Amen.

days.title: Stop and Listen
days.declaration: When someone calls your name, stopping is the wise thing. It keeps you safe.

scripture.text: Listen, my son, to your father's instruction.

days.title: Telling the Truth
days.declaration: When something breaks, you can tell us. We would rather know than be surprised.

scripture.text: Speak truthfully to your neighbour.

days.title: Asking Is Good
days.declaration: If you do not know, ask. Clever people ask lots of questions.

scripture.text: Ask God, who gives generously.

days.title: God Helps You Know
days.declaration: When you do not know what to do, God can help. You can ask Him too.

scripture.text: The Lord gives wisdom.

days.title: Wait a Moment
days.declaration: Waiting a moment before you do something is a very good habit.

scripture.text: Do you see someone who speaks in haste?

days.title: Some Things Are Not Safe
days.declaration: Some things are not safe, even when they look fun. We will help you learn which.

scripture.text: The prudent see danger and take refuge.

days.title: Listening to Kind Grown-Ups
days.declaration: Listen to the grown-ups who look after you. They are trying to keep you safe.

scripture.text: Keep your father's command.

days.title: Not Everyone Is Right
days.declaration: Just because someone says something loudly does not make it true.

scripture.text: The first to speak seems right, till another comes forward.

days.title: Try It Again
days.declaration: If something does not work, try a different way. That is being clever.

scripture.text: Though the righteous fall seven times, they rise again.

days.title: Being Told Off
days.declaration: Being told off does not mean you are bad. It means we are helping you learn.

scripture.text: The Lord disciplines those he loves.

days.title: Owning Up
days.declaration: Owning up is brave. It is much better than hiding.

scripture.text: Whoever conceals their sins does not prosper.

days.title: Thinking First
days.declaration: Thinking before you do it is called being wise. You can practise that.

scripture.text: The prudent give thought to their steps.

days.title: Words Are Powerful
days.declaration: What you say makes a difference. Pick good words.

scripture.text: Gracious words are a honeycomb.

days.title: Not Copying Everything
days.declaration: You do not have to do something just because someone else did.

scripture.text: Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong.

days.title: Learning Every Day
days.declaration: You learn something new every single day. That never stops.

scripture.text: Let the wise listen and add to their learning.

days.title: Saying I Do Not Know
days.declaration: It is fine to say you do not know. Pretending is what causes trouble.

scripture.text: The prudent keep their knowledge to themselves.

days.title: Being Careful
days.declaration: Being careful is not being scared. Careful people get to do more things.

scripture.text: The prudent see danger and take refuge.

days.title: Kind and Clever
days.declaration: The best clever people are kind as well. Be both.

scripture.text: The wisdom from above is peace-loving, considerate.

days.title: Listening to Your Tummy
days.declaration: When something feels wrong, that feeling is worth listening to. Tell someone.

scripture.text: Their consciences also bearing witness.

days.title: Doing What You Said
days.declaration: If you said you would, do it. That is how people learn to trust you.

scripture.text: Let your yes be yes.

days.title: Books and Questions
days.declaration: Books are full of things nobody has told you yet. Keep looking in them.

scripture.text: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge.

days.title: Slow Down
days.declaration: Slowing down helps you do things properly. Fast is not always better.

scripture.text: The plans of the diligent lead to profit.

days.title: Two Sides
days.declaration: When two people are cross, both of them have something to say. Listen to both.

scripture.text: To answer before listening is folly.

days.title: God Is God
days.declaration: God is God and we are not. Knowing that is where all wisdom starts.

scripture.text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

days.title: Practice Makes Better
days.declaration: Doing something over and over is how you get good. That is not failing.

scripture.text: I press on toward the goal.

days.title: Sharing What You Know
days.declaration: If you know something helpful, tell someone else. Knowing is for sharing.

scripture.text: Entrust to reliable people.

days.title: Rest Helps You Think
days.declaration: When you are tired, everything is harder. Sleep helps you be clever.

scripture.text: He grants sleep to those he loves.

days.title: Not Too Small to Be Wise
days.declaration: You are not too small to be wise. Wise is not the same as big.

scripture.text: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young.

days.title: Ask Again
days.declaration: If you asked and still do not understand, ask again. Nobody minds.

scripture.text: Ask and it will be given to you.

days.title: Growing Wiser
days.declaration: You get a bit wiser every year, for your whole life. There is no end to it.

scripture.text: Jesus grew in wisdom and stature.

days.title: Take It With You
days.declaration: What you learned today comes with you tomorrow. None of it gets lost.

scripture.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart.
